brief:
Israeli warplanes conducted a series of airstrikes across southern and eastern Lebanon on Friday evening, killing five people and injuring 24 others, Lebanese sources told Shehab Wire. The strikes targeted scattered locations throughout both regions in what authorities described as a coordinated bombing campaign.

The raids came shortly after the Israeli military announced the start of an operation, though the full scope and stated objectives remained unclear. Casualty figures were confirmed by Lebanese medical and security officials responding to the strikes across multiple impact sites in the two regions.
